---
title: "billing.ibm_verify_resource_units"
description: "IBM Verify resource units consumed each month, by product group."
---

The resource units the CanadaLogin IBM Verify tenant consumed each month, split
by product group, as reported in the IBM Verify billing export.

Each row is one product group in one usage month.

`Keywords`: billing, resource units, RU, usage, cost, invoice, IBM Verify, single sign-on, MFA, adaptive access

## Provenance

Sourced from a resource-unit CSV exported by hand from IBM Verify each month and
loaded by the
[monthly billing Lambda](https://github.com/cds-snc/canadalogin-reporting-data-pipeline/blob/main/infra/modules/upload_source/ibm_verify_monthly_billing/lambda_src/handler.py).
Each export covers all past months. A new upload updates earlier months as
well as adding the latest one.

* **Updated**: Manually, monthly
* **Retention**: Indefinitely
* **Steward**: EDCP Data and Research Team
* **Contact**: [Yinlin Zhang](mailto:yinlin.zhang@cds-snc.ca) (Data and Research team)

## Fields

| Field Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `usage_month` | `date` | First day of the usage month. |
| `usage_group` | `string` | IBM Verify product group. One of `Single sign-on`, `Multi-factor authentication`, `Adaptive access`, or `Lifecycle management and governance` |
| `resource_units` | `decimal` | Resource units consumed by `usage_group` in `usage_month` |
| `upload_date` | `date` | Date the CSV supplying this row was uploaded, in Eastern Time |
| `uploaded_at` | `timestamp` | When the CSV supplying this row was uploaded to S3, in UTC |
| `source_key` | `string` | S3 key of the CSV supplying this row, ending in the original filename |

## Notes

**The latest month is partial.** An export covers usage only up to its export
date, so the row for the month the export was taken in is incomplete. The next
monthly upload replaces it with the full figure.

**Zero is a real value.** A group with no billable usage in a month has a row
with `resource_units = 0`, not a missing row.
